notes.title: New build available! Cloud Save, Full Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Prepare to dive into an even more captivating gaming adventure with our latest update! We've fine-tuned the gameplay balance, added robust support for Steam Cloud Saves, and harnessed the power of full Gamepad compatibility, ensuring an unforgettable experience on the upcoming Steam Deck.

[b]Key Updates[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Optimized Balancing Fixes:[/b] Immerse yourself in a more refined and engaging gameplay experience as we've meticulously fine-tuned the game's balance. Y

[*][b]Seamless Steam Cloud Save:[/b] Say goodbye to progress worries! With Steam Cloud Save support, your game data is securely stored in the cloud. Switch between devices effortlessly and continue your adventure right where you left off.

[*][b]Full Gamepad Mastery:[/b] Unleash the true potential of your gaming prowess with complete Gamepad support. Whether you're using a controller or the upcoming Steam Deck, the controls are intuitive and responsive, providing a seamless and immersive experience.

[/list]

notes.title: February 2023 Update is here!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who has played our game so far! We're so happy that you've decided to come along with us on our journey.

A few major updates to this:

[list]
[*] [b]NEW FEATURE - Procedurally Generated Obstacles![/b] We've added more challenges to arcade mode. Test your agility and dodge around these obstacles to gain energy for your special attack
[*] [b]Quality of Life Update - Automatic Round Selection[/b]! Stay in the flow and have the game automatically pick the furthest round your credits can afford. You can still manually choose the difficulty if you'd like to play on an easier level
[*] [b]Updated UI[/b] - we've touched up our in-game UI a bit to be clearer, especially about health
[*] [b]Patched scaling and balancing[/b] - we've done a bit of rebalancing to make sure the game stays fun and not too challenging
[/list]
